summary: Read-only reconnaissance of the formal-lane governance on d6g8k5htny-coder/main at origin/main f6deeba775c27e731366d4772dfe58744425236f (2026-10-10). The lane has ONE contract and two packages (Math- Mathlib pilot, main core-Lean SIDE24 arithmetic skeleton, 31 targets). Vocabulary: formal-progress labels none/specified/proved/kernel-checked (docs/FORMAL_VERIFICATION.md:35); `proved` is the only value a committed manifest may carry (tools/formal_gate_check.py:138); `kernel-checked` exists only in the receipt of a trusted --run-lean (gate:288-290); alignment is a separate pending/accepted/stale dimension with manifest value fixed at PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW and per-target verdicts ALIGNED / ALIGNED AT NARROWER SCOPE / MISALIGNED (formal/REVIEW_LANE.md:35-37); L0-L5 ladder is defined in issue #95 body §C and a trusted kernel-checked receipt is "L5 evidence for exactly that target" (rollout:84-85). Gate: source-only mode checks manifest shape/self-award refusal, SHA-256 of every bound file, toolchain v4.34.1, lock==dependency_revisions, root imports exactly the registered modules, no sorry/native_decide/axiom outside comments, target inventory == theorem declarations in order, pinned sources byte-identical and from the five public repos, verbatim informal anchors, does_not_claim nonempty, no unregistered/unbound files, ALIGNMENT.md regenerated; --run-lean additionally does fresh lake build, leanchecker, transitive #print axioms restricted to propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound, elaborated types, 7 manifest mutation controls (REJECTED_BY_LEAN) + sorry/custom_imported/native controls (REJECTED_BY_AXIOM_GATE), re-check of manifest digest, Lean version check, and writes receipt.json with checked_commit, repository, workflow_run_id, lean_version, axioms, negative_controls, log digests. Required check on main is the single context `verify` (workspace-landing.yml:66-79) = aggregate over landing-checks + formal-verification.yml; tools/required_formal_check.py binds receipt to GITHUB_SHA==git HEAD, repository, run id, run attempt, manifest digest, log digests, and the aggregate refuses any non-success dependency; main also requires public-intake and public-shop (ruleset 23798639, zero approving reviews, pre-existing RepositoryRole5 bypass). Adding targets requires: theorem/lemma at column 0 inside the module's single namespace, manifest target row with fixed six-key schema and verbatim anchor from a byte-pinned public source copy, module registered in source_modules and root import, --refresh-hashes then --write-alignment then gate then --run-lean, updating tests/test_formal_gate.py:331-332 (hard-coded 31 targets, empty deps), SCOPE.md row with "Not established", any new refusal mirrored in Math- gate, claim in the relevant PR/#275 with the PR template's Current disposition block, author object kept author-side; alignment only by a reviewer differing in provider, family and agent; any source/scope/toolchain/manifest change stales prior alignment. Scope constraints: #95 §C "Do not attempt to formalize the entire stochastic-topology theorem first"; real-number statements belong in the Math- Mathlib package, not a second dependency tree on main (CONTRIBUTING.md:189-192); unformalised parents are explicit hypotheses, never axioms; LEAN_AUDIT_OWNER requires coverage by exact dependency slices with NOT ASSESSED for anything uninspected. Statement-only recording: the word `specified` exists but main has NO mechanism for it — the gate refuses any formalization_status but `proved`, refuses sorry/axiom, receipts with `specified` are refused by both binders; rollout:64-67 says "not yet formalised" is described in prose (SCOPE.md "Not established", work-offer table, GLOSSARY Lean column), not as register rows. Open asks: non-Anthropic alignment review of the 31 main targets (formal/reviews holds only the template), gate unification or package transfer to Math-, exact c_{d,ref} definition and proof-producing enclosure, ρ* as next full-theorem target, probability interface I1-I4, museum formalization view, Blueprint/Coq deferred; stale pointer lakefile.toml:7-8 to a README "Expansion path" section that no longer exists; VERIFICATION_LEVELS.json cited in #95 comment 5842121882 is not on origin/main.

vocabulary.meaning: Existing provenance, scope, review and CI system: hashes, STATUS.md, PROOF_INDEX.md, source-bound review, public-intake guard. Owns ACCEPT/AMEND verdicts.
The Lean layer: statements and proofs checked by the Lean kernel and bound by hash to Layer 0 bytes.

One registered Lean theorem/lemma declaration (namespace-qualified name) with manifest row {name, module, title, source, informal_anchor, does_not_claim}. The target inventory must equal, in order, the theorem/lemma declarations found in the registered modules. Kernel evidence is 'for exactly the manifest's targets at the checked commit'.
A verbatim quote from the pinned source bytes that a Lean target is attached to; verified as a substring by the gate.
Mandatory nonempty per-target field naming what the Lean statement does not establish; rendered in ALIGNMENT.md.
SCOPE.md table column giving, per target group, the analytic content outside the Lean statement; 'a visible boundary, not a defect and not a claim'.

receipt.json written by --run-lean only after build, leanchecker, axiom audit, elaborated types and all negative controls succeed and the manifest digest is unchanged. Fields: schema_version, scientific_effect NONE, scientific_status_authority false, package, formalization_status kernel-checked, alignment_status PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW, manifest_sha256, checked_commit (git HEAD), repository (GITHUB_REPOSITORY), workflow_run_id (GITHUB_RUN_ID), lean_version, dependency_revisions, axioms {target: [..]}, negative_controls {label: outcome}, logs {name.log: sha256}. A caller-supplied receipt is untrusted until matched to the actual workflow run and commit. A receipt is a record of a computation, not evidence of acceptance.

Produced by the author (human or model) and not yet checked by a distinct reviewer; applies equally to AI-generated Lean text; label stays until a distinct reviewer's record validates.
A distinct reviewer's check that a Lean statement says what the informal statement says at the stated scope; does not re-prove (kernel did) and does not grade Layer 0 mathematics.

JSON validated by --alignment: disposition ACCEPTED, manifest_sha256, scope_sha256 (= files['formal/SCOPE.md']), targets exactly the manifest's, author/reviewer {provider, family, agent} all pairwise different (casefold), evidence {repository owner/name, 40-hex commit, path, sha256}; plus source_exposure. Validation is structural; authenticating that the review happened is a controller's job.
An independent AI prover producing a proof of the same Lean statement; extra evidence, same kernel, still author-side; requires actual availability, pinned identity and recorded execution.

A table row offering formal work (reviewer, engineering reviewer, probability formalizer, numerical formalizer, acceptance/museum integrator); 'not assertions that other agents have accepted or completed them'; pickup recorded in the existing issue/PR.
The formal conclusion uses the premise as a hypothesis; Lean has not thereby proved that premise. Unformalised parent dependencies are stated as explicit hypotheses of the target, never as axioms.
Coverage label for any source claim not inspected; must not be inferred covered from target counts.
Mandatory manifest and receipt declarations; the gate refuses a manifest saying otherwise.

Owner-facing attribution for delegated reviews; must be followed by the actual performer/provider/agent; machine reviewer/lineage fields identify the performer, never the principal; delegation earns zero organizational-independence credit and cannot fill a formal-alignment requirement.
One axis of a derived evidence profile: 'Kernel-checked gate receipt and separate accepted alignment review'; an axis without a record reads `not recorded`, never a pass.
PASS_TECHNICAL / AMEND / FAIL / CANNOT_VERIFY / IN_REVIEW / NOT_REASSESSED — digest only; independence credit recorded separately (0 default).
